content: asynq (Go, Redis-backed task queue): at-least-once execution, automatic retries, worker crash recovery, weighted/strict priority queues, unique task deduplication, timeouts/deadlines, task aggregation into groups for batch processing, queue pausing, Prometheus metrics, asynqmon web UI + CLI for inspection. Redis-backed (not the app's primary DB), single-task focus rather than multi-step workflow orchestration.
